top_choice_rationale: P003 pairs two achievements that each turn a biological process into a defined, measurable chemical reaction and gave biologists a general tool, both reproduced independently: base editing (Liu) as deaminase chemistry on a single nucleobase, and heterobifunctional degraders (Crews, Deshaies) as event-driven induced-proximity chemistry with measurable ternary-complex formation and degradation kinetics. The citations are narrow and traceable. P001 (single degrader part including Handa and the cereblon glue mechanism) is a close second: scientifically strong but it spans two separable discoveries. Perovskites follow on solid evidence but weaker chemical-mechanism fit; phase separation is last among awards because its in vivo scope is not yet established by measurement.
